name: All Tests and Builds

env:
  # It's really `--all-features`, but not adding the mutually exclusive features from rkyv
  ALL_NON_EXCLUSIVE_FEATURES: --features "default unstable-locales rkyv-32 rkyv-validation serde arbitrary"

on:

    branches: [main, 0.5.x]
  pull_request:

      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        tz: ["ACST-9:30", "EST4", "UTC0", "Asia/Katmandu"]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - run: cargo test ${{ env.ALL_NON_EXCLUSIVE_FEATURES }} --color=always -- --color=always

  # later this may be able to be included with the below
  # kept separate for now as the following don't compile on 1.60
  # * arbitrary (requires 1.63 as of v1.3.0)

    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: "1.62.0"
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      # run --lib and --doc to avoid the long running integration tests
      # which are run elsewhere
      - run: |
          cargo check --lib --features unstable-locales,wasmbind,oldtime,clock,winapi,serde

  rust_versions:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest]
        rust_version: ["stable", "beta", "nightly"]

      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

          toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust_version }}
          components: rustfmt
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - run: cargo check --manifest-path bench/Cargo.toml --benches
      - run: cargo check --manifest-path fuzz/Cargo.toml --all-targets
      # run --lib and --doc to avoid the long running integration tests
      # which are run elsewhere
      - run: cargo test --lib ${{ env.ALL_NON_EXCLUSIVE_FEATURES }} --color=always -- --color=always
      - run: cargo test --doc ${{ env.ALL_NON_EXCLUSIVE_FEATURES }} --color=always -- --color=always

  features_check:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest]

            --all-targets
        # run using `bash` on all platforms for consistent
        # line-continuation marks
        shell: bash
        env:
          RUSTFLAGS: "-D warnings"
      - run: cargo test --no-default-features
      - run: cargo test --no-default-features --features=alloc
      - run: cargo test --no-default-features --features=unstable-locales
      - run: cargo test --no-default-features --features=alloc,unstable-locales
      - run: cargo test --no-default-features --features=now

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
